description: Install dependencies and verify the build passes on the existing codebase before making changes.
steps: Run npm install in /projects/sandbox/WorkDays to install all dependencies
Run npm run build to verify the existing codebase compiles without errors
Create a new feature branch named 'feature/workdays-modules' from main
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors
Feature branch 'feature/workdays-modules' is created and checked out
findings: Build requires Supabase env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY). Created .env.local with placeholder values to allow build to pass. This file is already excluded from git by .gitignore pattern '.env*.local'. npm install produced deprecation warning for next@14.2.18 (security vulnerability) and 2 audit vulnerabilities (1 high, 1 critical), but these do not block the build.
